description: Ministry of Labour - Order to appoint 27.05.2015 as on the date on which the provinsions of Subpara (i) and 01.06.2015 as on the date of Subpara (ii) of Subsec. (1) of Sec. 23A of the Employees' Provident Fund Act, No. 15 of 1958 which come into operation
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an order under Section 23A(6) of the Employees' Provident Fund Act, No. 15 of 1958. It appoints specific dates for provisions of the Act to come into operation. While it mentions the Minister of Labour by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only his title "Minister of Labour"), and the core content is about implementing legal provisions of an existing Act rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganization. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for statutory instruments and regulatory implementation.
